software_lock.lens_mapping_use: coordinate map and nuisance generator only; no published E325 lens posterior or GR mass inference is imported

coordinate_lens_fit.optimizer: bounded Powell on the coadd semilinear objective

semilinear_source.psf_operator: 11x11 central truncation of each normalized common-PSF member, renormalized after truncation
semilinear_source.amplitude_selection: minimum held-out F475W-visit chi-square with the smallest amplitude within delta-chi-square one of the minimum
semilinear_source.linear_solver: sparse LSMR on whitened image rows plus the regularization operator
semilinear_source.reason_source_positivity_not_used: local nuisance rank must not be artificially raised by an active inequality boundary

response_basis.quantity: axisymmetric radial image-plane deflection perturbation added after the fitted coordinate lens map
response_basis.cardinal_basis: natural cubic splines through zero at 0 and 4 arcsec and one at one response knot
response_basis.derivative: symmetric central finite difference of the PSF-convolved source mapping at fixed reconstructed source

nuisance_projection.source_block: every pixel of the selected source grid with the same selected regularizer
image_block: x and y image gradients for relative astrometry
lens_block: m=3 cosine and sine angular deflection
m=4 cosine and sine angular deflection
nuisance_projection.psf_block: all 35 non-nominal frozen PSF predictions relative to the nominal prediction
nuisance_projection.radial_amplitude_and_slope_treatment: theta_E and gamma define the coordinate-map origin but are not added as separate nuisance columns because their local radial information is contained in the four tested response directions; the explicit mass-sheet direction remains marginalized
nuisance_projection.method: regularized Schur-complement projection implemented by sparse least squares of every response column on the combined nuisance block

variant_grid.psf_stability: all 36 frozen PSF members enter the nuisance block; repeat the full rank calculation at the 0.9x, 1.0x, and 1.1x circular core-width anchors

concrete_outcomes.advance: All 108 anchor calculations retain rank >=3, every rank/control threshold passes, the negative control has rank zero, and held-out predictions pass. This establishes structural image rank only.
concrete_outcomes.partial: Any stable rank of one or two is recorded as the E325 structural ceiling and cannot be promoted.
concrete_outcomes.fail: Coordinate/source predictive closure or synthetic coverage failure ends the E325 promotion attempt even if raw singular values appear large.
